messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — we've seen a small spike in blackbox probe failures hitting the embeddings endpoint in us-west-2 over the last 10m. ~3.8% failed (probe timeout / upstream 503).
Jon Ruiz: saw a blip in us-east1 too but those were connection resets, not 503s. possibly different root cause.
SRE-bot: ALERT: blackbox_probe_failure_rate{job=\"blackbox\",region=\"us-west-2\"} > 1% for 5m — triggered at 2026-03-02T14:13:30Z :rotating_light:
Maya Patel: tagging @infra-ops and @Liam. can we confirm whether a recent infra rollout touched the NAT gateway or firewall rules in us-west-2?
infra-ops: No infra rollouts in us-west-2 in the window. Network ACLs unchanged. We did finish a kernel update on a subset of GPU hosts but that's internal to dedicated pool.
Liam O'Connor: can we get the raw blackbox exporter logs? Also check scrape timeout and module settings — streaming/long-poll endpoints need longer timeouts.
Maya Patel: grabbing logs now. Quick note: our embedding probe does a POST with a 1-token prompt and expects an immediate vector. The probe uses `http_2xx` module with timeout 5s.
Maya Patel: log excerpt: ```
time=\"2026-03-02T14:12:45Z\" level=warning msg=\"probe failed\" module=http_2xx target=https://embed-west.redwood.ai/probe id=abc123 error=\"net/http: request canceled (Client.Timeout exceeded while awaiting headers)\"
```
Jon Ruiz: that looks like upstream slowness. PromQL to confirm: `sum(rate(blackbox_probe_failed_total{job=\"blackbox\",probe=\"embed-check\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(blackbox_probe_total{job=\"blackbox\",probe=\"embed-check\"}[5m]))` shows 0.038 for us-west-2 over 10m.
Liam O'Connor: fyi, our current Grafana panel uses `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(go_gc_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))` — which is wrong for HTTP latency. We should use `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{handler=~\"/v1/embeddings.*\"}[5m])) by (le))` to get accurate p95.
Anya Singh: Suggestion: rather than immediate paging the team on any >1% over 5m, tune alerts to: - only fire if failure rate >2% for 10m OR p99 latency >2s for 5m. This avoids noisy alerts from transient network hiccups.
Maya Patel: Agreed. Also we should differentiate streaming vs non-streaming probes. Streaming embed flows keep a socket longer; blackbox's http_2xx might consider partial bytes as success. We need a probe that validates full response shape.
SRE-bot: auto-note: Created issue INF-7267 \"embed probe: validate vector length + hash\" and assigned to @Maya.
Maya Patel: proposal for a stronger synthetic probe (pseudo-config): ```yaml
modules:
  embed_full:
    prober: http
    timeout: 8s
    http:
      method: POST
      headers:
        Content-Type: application/json
      body: '{"input": "test probe"}'
      valid_http_versions: ["HTTP/1.1","HTTP/2"]
      fail_if_not_ssl: true
      tls_config:
        insecure_skip_verify: false
      expected_status: [200]
      expected_json_path:
        - path: $.data[0].embedding
          type: array
          min_len: 8
      expect_hash: "sha256:7e5f..."  # optional quick integrity check
```
Jon Ruiz: nice. That `expected_json_path` will catch truncated/partial streams. Also we should add `max_body_size` and ensure the blackbox exporter handles chunked responses.
Liam O'Connor: For Prometheus alerts, here's a draft rule we can PR:
```
- alert: SyntheticEmbeddingFailures
  expr: |
    sum by (region)(rate(blackbox_probe_failed_total{probe=\"embed_full\"}[10m]))
    / sum by (region)(rate(blackbox_probe_total{probe=\"embed_full\"}[10m])) > 0.02
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: critical
  annotations:
    summary: \"Synthetic embedding probe failure rate in {{ $labels.region }} > 2%\"
    runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embed-probe
```
Anya Singh: Also add a separate latency alert using histogram_quantile(0.99) for embedding endpoints (5m window) and only page on multi-region impact.
infra-ops: cost note — running `embed_full` every 15s across all regions is expensive. Current sampling: every 15s in prod primary regions, every 1m in secondaries. If we add `expected_json_path` checks (i/o), CPU cost on blackbox boxes will rise ~15%. We should consider sampling weights: 75% of scrapes do a light check, 25% do full integrity probe.
Maya Patel: good call. Proposed schedule: primary regions: 30s light check, 2m full check; secondaries: 1m light, 5m full. This keeps coverage but limits cost.
Liam O'Connor: I'll open the prometheus alert PR and the blackbox config PR. @Anya can you update the Grafana panels: split streaming vs non-streaming panels and add an SLO heatmap for embed success rate?
Anya Singh: on it. I'll add a panel with rolling burn rate for the 99% SLO and an alert rule that only escalates to pager when burn rate > 6x and affected_regions > 1.
Jon Ruiz: action items: 1) PR alert + blackbox config (Liam) 2) Grafana panel + SLO update (Anya) 3) infra sampling + cost ack (infra-ops) 4) implement `embed_full` integrity check (Maya)
Maya Patel: thanks all. I'll post PR links here once ready. :thumbsup:
SRE-bot: NOTE: Scheduled job `synthetic-embed-canary` will run at 2026-03-02T15:00:00Z to validate the new probe in staging.
